Drake Batherson Signs Eight-Year Contract Extension with Ottawa Senators

The Ottawa Senators have signed forward Drake Batherson to an eight-year contract extension. The deal is reportedly the longest in franchise history for the team. Specific financial terms of the contract were not immediately disclosed in the coverage.
